steps.name: discover
steps.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
npm run discover
node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(".discovery.json"));fs.writeFileSync("$(results.changed.path)",String(d.changed));fs.writeFileSync("$(results.fingerprint.path)",d.inputDigest)'

params.name: SCRIPT
params.value:
set -eu
export CATALOG_URL="https://eventcatalog-demo.apps.cluster-ggvsm.dyn.redhatworkshops.io"
export NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096
mkdir -p public/LICENSES
cp node_modules/@eventcatalog/core/LICENSE public/LICENSES/EventCatalog.txt
cp node_modules/@eventcatalog/core/NOTICE public/LICENSES/EventCatalog-NOTICE.txt
cp node_modules/@eventcatalog/generator-asyncapi/LICENSE public/LICENSES/AsyncAPI-generator.txt
npm run generate
npm run build
